description: Pancratiusplein in Heerlen holds three different buildings. The Sint-Pancratiuskerk has a heavy medieval tower and a Romanesque nave. Beside it stands the shorter Schelmentoren, a rubble-stone defensive tower. Across the square is the Glaspaleis, a glass cube from the 1930s, with no lettering. The sky is clear, about 15.6°C, with wind near 12.6 km/h.
